speaker: (the templar)
text: I came in to praise Berowne, and I will say that first. Master Burbage, the yard was in your pocket. I am of the Inner Temple. We came, though the term is done.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You are kind, sir. The rhymes were the play's. I trusted them. Sit, if you have walked from the Temple to say so.

speaker: (the templar)
text: I have other news, and it will not keep company with praise for long. The Jesuit Southwell was tried at Westminster today, before the Lord Chief Justice, for treason, and condemned.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The mutton is still the mutton. George, pass it down. Sir, you are at our supper, and you may have bread while you speak.

speaker: (the templar)
text: He told the court he was about the age of our Saviour. Thirty-three. A poet. Some of the benchers have his verses by heart, and would not own to it at their own table. I own only to having heard so.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The watchet gown, then, since we are in a parlour and not at Westminster. Fifty shillings, John. The boy wore it this afternoon as if the mercer had already been paid.

speaker: john_heminges
text: He has not been paid. Item, we do not spend seven pound eleven on a debt that can wait. The supper is the supper. Sir, you have given us the sentence. I have no column for the rest.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The blue held. Nick's wrists stayed covered. Thou didst not see one out of place, Will, if thou art still with us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: When is it to be?

speaker: (the templar)
text: Tomorrow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I thank you. You were good to come in about Berowne.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The gown, as I said, and it is not paid. Edith is still owed her eight shillings, which is another bill. I am talking of cloth because the other subject is not meat, and this table has already heard the news once.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Edith's eight is the stock's, and it is not paid tonight. George, the gown is a true bill. What the gentleman brought from the Temple is not an item I can enter, and I am not going to pretend it is.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art very courteous, Will, and thou art somewhere else. Eat, or give me the bread. The play is played. This is a young man's report of a court none of us sat in.

speaker: (the templar)
text: I was not in the court. I had it in the Temple within the hour. I have given you the part the accounts shared. Thirty-three. A poet. Condemned. I will not ornament it, and I did not see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow. You said tomorrow. I heard that.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And the gown is watchet, and it is not paid, and Nick did not disgrace it. John, do we know the week of the mercer, or only that the week is not this one?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Not this one. I will not name a week I cannot keep. The— the boxes are counted. The gown is a line. That is as far as I am brave tonight.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then stay there. Thou, Will, the cup is by your hand. A quiet yard was a true thing. Leave this other news where the young man set it. I am not your scholar in it.

speaker: (the templar)
text: I have kept you from your meat. Berowne was the better errand. I am sorry the other came in behind it. I will go when I have said the one word you asked. Tomorrow. That was the word.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Sit, if you are sorry, and finish the bread. A man who brings a praise and a sorrow in the same quarter-hour should not be turned out on the sorrow. John, is there a cup for him, or only items?

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let him have the cup, John, and let Will have the door when he wants it. I am not keeping a man at a table he has already left.

speaker: (the templar)
text: I will take the cup. I will not pay for it with a second piece of news.

speaker: john_heminges
text: There is a cup. I do not itemise a kindness that is already poured. Tomorrow is tomorrow. It is not this parlour's bill to pay. Seven pound eleven was a good house. I am not mixing the two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. Do not mix them. I am for the lodging when this cup is done. You have all been very good. I heard the praise, and I heard tomorrow, and the gown can be talked of without me.
